problem.name: Oracle identification
problem.statement_latex: A known concept set $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^N$ has size $M$. Given bit queries to an unknown $x\in C$, identify $x$. Complexity is worst case over concept sets with the given $N,M$, allowing unrestricted processing of $C$.
problem.statement_text: A known concept set $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^N$ has size $M$. Given bit queries to an unknown $x\in C$, identify $x$. Complexity is worst case over concept sets with the given $N,M$, allowing unrestricted processing of $C$.

strength.description_latex: Polynomial improvement in the stated resource and parameter regime.
strength.description_text: Polynomial improvement in the stated resource and parameter regime.

evidence.description_latex: The cited results establish a classical lower bound separating the stated quantum resource bound in the specified model.

hardware.description_latex: The algorithm requires coherent input access and fault-tolerant execution of the stated procedure; its circuit and workspace requirements depend on that access implementation.
hardware.description_text: The algorithm requires coherent input access and fault-tolerant execution of the stated procedure; its circuit and workspace requirements depend on that access implementation.

quantum.headline_latex: $\Theta(\sqrt M)$ queries for $M\le N$, and $\Theta(\sqrt{N\log M/(\log(N/\log M)+1)})$ for $N<M\le2^N$, by Kothari's optimal identification algorithm.
quantum.headline_text: $\Theta(\sqrt M)$ queries for $M\le N$, and $\Theta(\sqrt{N\log M/(\log(N/\log M)+1)})$ for $N<M\le2^N$, by Kothari's optimal identification algorithm.

classical.headline_latex: $\Theta(\min\{N,M\})$ randomized queries in the worst case over concept sets, by classical elimination and the corresponding hard classes.
classical.headline_text: $\Theta(\min\{N,M\})$ randomized queries in the worst case over concept sets, by classical elimination and the corresponding hard classes.
